title: Publish
intro: When you're ready, bundle your changes into a commit to GitHub, where your site rebuilds and goes live in about two minutes.
release_unknown: We couldn't check which Telar release is the latest, so publishing is paused. Try again in a moment.

chips.nothing_changing: Nothing has changed since your last publish.

publish_section.blocked_note: Fix the items above before publishing.
publish_section.language_choice_note: Choose which version of each page to keep before you publish.

failure_card.heading: Build failed
failure_card.description: Something went wrong while building your site.
failure_card.private_repo: Your repository is private, and GitHub Pages doesn't publish private repositories on free GitHub accounts. Make the repository public, or use a paid GitHub account, then publish again.

review.up_to_date_description: No changes since your last publish.
review.state_unavailable: We couldn't check what will be published
review.state_unavailable_description: We couldn't reach your editing session, so we can't show you the changes right now. Nothing has been lost — reload the page in a moment.
review.header_spelling_description: Nothing has changed since your last publish, but your site may not recognize some column headings in {{files}}. Publish your site to correct them.

checks.heading: Pre-publish checks
checks.state_unavailable: We couldn't see your site's current content, so these checks didn't run. Reload the page in a moment.
checks.may_be_behind: These checks may not include your latest edits. Check again in a moment.
checks.failed: We couldn't run these checks, and you can't publish without them. Try again in a moment.
checks.first_publish_title: Your first publish from the Compositor
checks.first_publish_body: It writes your site's files in the Compositor's layout. Nothing in them is lost:
checks.first_publish_sheets: <0>project.csv</0> and the story sheets get a Spanish header row and the columns this release reads
checks.first_publish_texts: story texts move into <0>telar-content/texts/stories/</0>, one file per panel
checks.github_unchecked: Couldn't check GitHub just now, so the Compositor can't tell whether anyone has committed since your last publish. Publishing waits until it can.
checks.workflow_repair_build_unchecked: We couldn't check on the rebuild just now. We'll keep trying.
checks.stale_head: Someone committed to your repository after your last publish. Choose what to keep before you publish again.
checks.stale_head_collab: Someone committed to the repository after the last publish. {{name}}, who coordinates this site, chooses which versions to keep. You can keep editing; publishing waits until then.
checks.stale_head_collab_unnamed: Someone committed to the repository after the last publish. The person who coordinates this site chooses which versions to keep. You can keep editing; publishing waits until then.
checks.object_reserved_column: Object "{{id}}" has a column named "{{column}}" that Telar reserves for itself. Remove the column before publishing, or the site's next build will fail.
checks.glossary_reserved_column: Glossary term "{{id}}" has a column named "{{column}}" that Telar reserves for itself. Remove the column before publishing, or the site's next build will fail.
checks.object_id_comment_row: Object "{{id}}" has an ID beginning with #. Telar reads a row that starts with # as a comment, so publishing would drop this object from your site, and your next sync would read it back as a comment rather than an object. Change its ID on the object's page before publishing.
checks.glossary_id_comment_row: Glossary term "{{id}}" has an ID beginning with #. Telar reads a term ID that starts with # as a comment, so publishing would drop this term from your site, and your next sync would read it back as a comment rather than a term. Change the ID before publishing.
checks.objects_colliding_columns: The objects have columns Telar reads as one ({{columns}}) — keep only one and remove the rest before publishing, or the site's next build will fail.
checks.story_reserved_column: Story "{{story}}" has a column named "{{column}}" that Telar reserves for itself. Remove the column before publishing, or the site's next build will fail.
checks.story_colliding_columns: Story "{{story}}" has columns Telar reads as one ({{columns}}). Remove all but one before publishing, or the site's next build will fail.
checks.column_remove_confirm: Removing "{{column}}" deletes its values. Rows that hold a value in it: {{count}}. You can't undo this.
checks.story_remove_column_failed: We couldn't remove the column "{{column}}". Try again in a moment.
checks.config_block_unwritable: The "{{block}}" section of _config.yml is written in a form the Compositor can't edit (on one line between braces, or through a YAML anchor or alias) — rewrite it as an indented block, one key per line, before publishing.
checks.config_unparseable: Your site's _config.yml is not valid YAML, so the Compositor cannot save your settings to it. Fix the file in your repository before publishing: until you do, what you change in Site settings will not reach the published site.
checks.glossary_shared_address: The glossary terms "{{kept}}" and "{{dropped}}" share one address on your site. The site publishes "{{kept}}" and does not publish "{{dropped}}", so links to "{{dropped}}" show as missing. Open Glossary and change one of the two IDs so they differ by more than capital letters or punctuation.
checks.glossary_shared_address_case: The glossary terms "{{kept}}" and "{{dropped}}" share one address on your site, because their IDs differ only in capital letters. The site publishes "{{kept}}" and does not publish "{{dropped}}", so links to "{{dropped}}" open "{{kept}}". Open Glossary and change one of the two IDs so they differ by more than capital letters.
checks.glossary_colliding_columns: The glossary has columns Telar reads as one ({{columns}}) — keep only one and remove the rest before publishing, or the site's next build will fail.
checks.story_id_refused: The ID "{{id}}" cannot be used for a story, because it would write over one of your site's sheets or is not a valid file name. Before publishing, open the story and change its ID to one with only lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores that is not project, proyecto, objects, objetos, glossary or glosario.
checks.story_no_title: Story "{{id}}" has no title — open Stories to give it a title, or delete it.
checks.step_answer_over_limit_one: The answer for step {{number}} of "{{story}}" is too long for the story's card. An answer may have up to {{max_paragraphs}} paragraphs and {{budget}} lines, counting {{line_chars}} characters to a line and {{break_lines}} lines for each paragraph after the first. This one has 1 paragraph and {{lines}} lines, so the published site will cut it. Shorten it, or move the detail into a layer panel, before publishing.
checks.step_answer_over_limit_other: The answer for step {{number}} of "{{story}}" is too long for the story's card. An answer may have up to {{max_paragraphs}} paragraphs and {{budget}} lines, counting {{line_chars}} characters to a line and {{break_lines}} lines for each paragraph after the first. This one has {{count}} paragraphs and {{lines}} lines, so the published site will cut it. Shorten it, or move the detail into a layer panel, before publishing.
checks.step_answer_has_image_one: The answer for step {{number}} of "{{story}}" has an image, but answers are text only — remove the image before publishing, or move it to a layer panel.
checks.step_answer_has_image_other: The answer for step {{number}} of "{{story}}" has {{count}} images, but answers are text only — remove the images before publishing, or move them to a layer panel.
checks.step_answer_has_embed_one: The answer for step {{number}} of "{{story}}" has an embedded element (a video or a map, for example), but answers are text only — remove it before publishing.
checks.step_answer_has_embed_other: The answer for step {{number}} of "{{story}}" has {{count}} embedded elements (videos or maps, for example), but answers are text only — remove them before publishing.
checks.step_answer_has_footnote_one: The answer for step {{number}} of "{{story}}" has a footnote, but answers are text only — remove the footnote before publishing, or move it to a layer panel.
checks.step_answer_has_footnote_other: The answer for step {{number}} of "{{story}}" has {{count}} footnotes, but answers are text only — remove the footnotes before publishing, or move them to a layer panel.
checks.step_answer_has_table_one: The answer for step {{number}} of "{{story}}" has a table, but answers are text only — remove the table before publishing, or move it to a layer panel.
checks.step_answer_has_table_other: The answer for step {{number}} of "{{story}}" has {{count}} tables, but answers are text only — remove the tables before publishing, or move them to a layer panel.
checks.step_answer_has_code_block_one: The answer for step {{number}} of "{{story}}" has a code block, but answers are text only — remove the code block before publishing, or move it to a layer panel.
checks.step_answer_has_code_block_other: The answer for step {{number}} of "{{story}}" has {{count}} code blocks, but answers are text only — remove the code blocks before publishing, or move them to a layer panel.
checks.step_answer_has_widget_one: The answer for step {{number}} of "{{story}}" has a widget (a block that starts with :::), but answers are text only — remove the widget before publishing, or move it to a layer panel.
checks.step_answer_has_widget_other: The answer for step {{number}} of "{{story}}" has {{count}} widgets (blocks that start with :::), but answers are text only — remove the widgets before publishing, or move them to a layer panel.
checks.step_answer_has_formatting: The answer for step {{number}} of "{{story}}" uses {{kinds, list}}, but answers are text only — the published site will show the words without that formatting.
checks.about_page_template: Your {{title}} page still has the text every new Telar site starts with, which describes Telar rather than your project. You might like to make it your own.
checks.page_no_title: A page has no title — open Pages to give it a title, or delete it.
checks.page_frontmatter_unwritable: The title of page "{{page}}" is written in a form the Compositor can't change without touching the rest of the settings block it sits in. To publish, keep only the title in the block, which removes the page's other settings, or edit the page's file on GitHub.
checks.page_frontmatter_reset_failed: We couldn't keep only the title in the settings block of page "{{page}}". Try again in a moment.
checks.page_frontmatter_replaced: The settings of the page "{{page}}" can't be read. Publishing will keep only its title and remove its other settings.
checks.step_no_position: Step {{number}} has no viewer position — the published site will show 100% of the image.
checks.story_file_kept_changed: The story file {{file}} was changed on GitHub after the Compositor read it. The story was deleted here, so publishing leaves the file as it is.
checks.renamed_duplicate_column: Two columns in {{file}} were both called "{{column}}". The second is saved as "{{renamed}}".
checks.renamed_duplicate_columns: {{total}} columns in {{file}} were all called "{{column}}". All but the first are saved under new names: {{renamed}}.
checks.private_story_no_key: These stories are private, but no story key is set: {{stories}}. The published site build will fail until you set a story key in Site settings.
checks.private_story_workflow_stale: These stories are private, but your site's build workflow is out of date and does not include the step that protects them: {{stories}}. The published site build will fail until you replace .github/workflows/build.yml with the current one from the Telar repository. <0>The upgrade notes explain how.</0>
checks.stories_leave_site: When you publish, these stories leave your live site: {{stories}}. Deleted stories and stories marked Draft are not published; to keep a draft on the site, turn Draft off.
checks.workflow_repair_done: The build workflow is up to date.
checks.workflow_repair_permission: GitHub did not let the Compositor update the workflow. <0>Review the Telar Compositor app's permissions on GitHub</0> and try again, or replace the file by hand as the upgrade notes explain.
checks.workflow_repair_permission_convenor_requ: GitHub did not let the Compositor update the workflow. Only the site's convenor can review and accept the app's permissions on GitHub. Ask them to, and try again once they have.
checks.workflow_repair_failed: The workflow could not be updated. Try again in a moment, or replace the file by hand as the upgrade notes explain.
checks.workflow_repair_building: The build workflow is up to date. Your site is rebuilding…
checks.workflow_repair_rebuilt: The build workflow is up to date and your site has been rebuilt.
checks.workflow_repair_build_failed: The build workflow is up to date, but the rebuild failed. <0>See the build details on GitHub</0>.
checks.workflow_repair_build_cancelled: The build workflow is up to date, but the rebuild was cancelled on GitHub. <0>See the build details on GitHub</0>.

auto_commit.bootstrap_note: (One-time content tracking refresh — future commits will list specific changes.)

commit.heading: Write a commit message
commit.description: A commit message describes what you changed. It helps you (and others) understand the history of your site.
commit.label: Commit message
commit.footer_note: This message will appear in your site's history on GitHub.

build.failed_description: Something went wrong while building your site.
build.publish_failed_description: We couldn't publish your changes to GitHub, so your site hasn't changed. Nothing you edited was lost. Try again in a moment.
build.github_permission: GitHub refused to save your changes, so your site hasn't changed. Nothing you edited was lost. Telar may no longer have access to the repository: ask whoever manages it on GitHub to check that the Telar Compositor GitHub App is still installed on it, then publish again.
build.stale_head_error: Your repository changed while publishing, so nothing was published. Review the changes made on GitHub, then publish again.
build.stale_head_error_collab: Your repository changed while publishing, so nothing was published. {{name}}, who coordinates this site, reviews the changes made on GitHub. Publish again once they have.
build.stale_head_error_collab_unnamed: Your repository changed while publishing, so nothing was published. The person who coordinates this site reviews the changes made on GitHub. Publish again once they have.
build.snapshot_failed: We couldn't save your latest edits, so publishing was stopped. Try again in a moment.
build.snapshot_unreachable: We couldn't reach your editing session. Publishing was stopped so your recent edits aren't left out.
build.snapshot_incomplete: We couldn't save part of your content, so publishing was stopped — publishing now would have left it off your site. Reload the page and try again.
build.validation_blocked: Publishing was stopped — something on your site must be fixed first. Reload the page to see what.
build.config_unreadable: We couldn't read your site's settings from GitHub. Publishing was stopped so they aren't left off your site. Try again in a moment.
build.page_unreadable: We couldn't read one of your site's pages from GitHub. Publishing was stopped so nothing on it is lost. Try again in a moment.
build.objects_unreadable: We couldn't read your site's list of objects from GitHub. Publishing was stopped so nothing in it is lost. Try again in a moment.
build.objects_unregistered: Some objects are saved in your site's files but don't appear in the Compositor yet, and we couldn't add them just now. Publishing was stopped so they don't disappear from your site. Try again in a moment.
build.landing_unreadable: We couldn't read your site's landing page from GitHub. Publishing was stopped so nothing on it is lost. Try again in a moment.
build.glossary_unreadable: We couldn't read your site's glossary from GitHub. Publishing was stopped so nothing in it is lost. Try again in a moment.
build.project_unreadable: We couldn't read your site's list of stories from GitHub. Publishing was stopped so nothing in it is lost. Try again in a moment.
build.operation_in_progress: A publish, upgrade or upload is already running on this site, so this one wasn't started. Try again once it has finished.
build.stories_unreadable: We couldn't read your site's stories from GitHub. Publishing was stopped so nothing in them is lost. Try again in a moment.
build.changed_during_publish: Someone edited a story while we were preparing to publish, so publishing was stopped. Publish again to include the change.
build.page_language_unchosen: Publishing was stopped: one of your pages is in two languages, and you haven't chosen which version to keep. Choose one above, then publish again.
build.page_language_not_applied: We couldn't keep the version you chose, because the page changed or couldn't be saved. Publishing was stopped and nothing changed. Reload the page and try again.

repo_unavailable.heading: Publishing is paused
repo_unavailable.lead: Telar can't reach the repository for this project ({{repo}}).
repo_unavailable.body: It may have been deleted, renamed, made private, or the Telar app's access to it was removed. Your work here is safe — everything you've edited in the Compositor is stored separately from the repository — but you can't publish until Telar can reach it again.

language_choice.heading: Your {{page}} page is in two languages
language_choice.body: A Telar site is in one language, but this page is in two files: {{files}}. Choose the one to keep. When you publish, the other version is deleted from your site.
language_choice.body_more: A Telar site is in one language, but this page is in {{number}} files: {{files}}. Choose the one to keep. When you publish, the other versions are deleted from your site.
language_choice.keep_other_note: Its text goes into {{page}}, so the page keeps its address and its place in your menu, and {{file}} is deleted.
